meta.name: data-storytelling
meta.description: Transform data into compelling narratives using visualization, context, and persuasive structure. Use when presenting analytics to stakeholders, creating data reports, or building executive presentations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用数据讲出有说服力的故事
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在汇报中把数据讲得动人
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to make your data presentations more compelling.

howto.what: 把原始数据改写成人人看得懂的叙事，先抛出核心洞察，再配背景与数据点，最后给出建议和下一步行动。会避开堆数字和术语，按“铺垫—冲突—解决”的结构组织内容。
howto.when: 当你请它向高管或利益相关者展示分析、做季度业务回顾、写数据报告或构建投资者演示时触发。

say.text: 把这份季度销售数据讲成故事给高管听
say.note: 它会把数据组织成有冲突和推荐的叙事。

say.text: 用数据讲故事的结构写一份业务回顾
say.note: 按铺垫—冲突—解决梳理，先给结论。

say.text: 帮我将分析结果做成带下一步行动的演示
say.note: 它会加上行动号召和核心洞察。

howto.what_en: Claude turns raw data into a clear narrative: it leads with the key insight, adds context and data points, then ends with recommendations and next steps. It avoids dumping numbers or jargon and organizes content in a setup-conflict-resolution structure.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to present analytics to executives or stakeholders, create quarterly business reviews, write data reports, or build investor presentations.

say_en.text: Turn this quarterly sales data into a story for executives.
say_en.note: It organizes the data into a narrative with conflict and recommendations.

say_en.text: Write a business review using data storytelling structure.
say_en.note: It leads with conclusions and follows setup-conflict-resolution.

say_en.text: Turn my analysis into a presentation with next steps.
say_en.note: It adds a call to action and the key insight.
